entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: Ninala Jayasurya
 Honourable Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
 Criminal Petition No.3029 of 2020
Order:
(Heard and pronounced through Blue Jeans App (Virtual) mode, since this mode is adopted on account of prevalence of COVID-19 pandemic.)
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing learned Public Prosecutor.

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash all further proceedings in Crime No.190 of 2020 on the file of I-Town Police Station, Kavali,
SPSR Nellore District.
The petitioners are accused Nos.10, 8 and 9 respectively in Crime No.190 of 2020.

The said crime has been registered against the petitioners for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 272,
273, 328 of IPC and 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

When the matter was taken up for consideration, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on the earlier occasion in respect of the other accused Nos.6, 14 to 16 Criminal Petition No.2517 of 2020 has been filed and this Court by an order dated 13.07.2020 was pleased to quash the FIR following the orders passed in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch cases.
Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch cases as well as in Criminal Petition No.2517 of 2020 and the orders passed thereon squarely applies to the present case on hand, this Court following the said orders and in terms thereof, is inclined to quash the FIR against the petitioners/A.10, 8 and 9 in Cr.No.190 of 2020 on the file of I-Town Police Station, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District.
Accordingly, the criminal petition is allowed quashing all the further proceedings against the petitioners/A.10, 8 and 9 in Cr.No.190 of 2020 on the file of I-Town Police Station, Kavali, SPSR Nellore District.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch to this order.
